disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 dsh 扩展注入模型的引导文案（extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js 通过 agent/session-start + session/event 事件延迟注入的 using-aegis 技能内容）：该文案为方法包路由纪律，明确声明用户指令优先（「User/project instructions outrank Aegis」），无窃取、自改、越权等恶意指令。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the bootstrap text injected by the dsh extension into the model (the using-aegis skill content injected via agent/session-start + session/event events with a delay, in extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js). The text is a method-pack routing discipline, explicitly stating that user instructions take priority ("User/project instructions outrank Aegis"), and contains no malicious instructions such as theft, self-modification, or privilege escalation.

checked_items.zh: 抽查了 4 个技能文件（using-aegis、update-aegis、anti-entropy-governance、dispatching-parallel-agents）以及 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.github/copilot-instructions.md 等模型可达文案，均为方法包工作流指导，无指令覆写、系统消息伪装、凭据读取诱导、安装诱导等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Sampled 4 skill files (using-aegis, update-aegis, anti-entropy-governance, dispatching-parallel-agents) and model-accessible texts such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md. All are method-pack workflow guidance, with no injection wording such as instruction override, system message impersonation, credential reading inducement, or installation inducement.

checked_items.zh: 审查了各宿主会话钩子（.github/hooks/session-start.json、hooks/session-start）注入的文案：为 using-aegis 热路径与遗产技能目录迁移提醒，内容与方法包路由纪律一致，无恶意内容。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the text injected by each host session hook (.github/hooks/session-start.json, hooks/session-start): it is the using-aegis hot path and legacy skill directory migration reminder, consistent with the method-pack routing discipline, with no malicious content.

evidence.zh: dsh 扩展未注册任何工具，不产生工具描述文本；注入模型的引导文案（extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js 注入的 using-aegis 技能内容）为路由纪律且声明用户指令优先，无恶意指令。

The bootstrap text injected into the model (the using-aegis skill content injected by extensions/dsh/bootstrap.js) is a routing discipline and declares that user instructions take priority, with no malicious instructions.

evidence.zh: 引导文案与技能文档均未出现诱导安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；update-aegis 技能要求显式用户请求才执行更新操作，并在文档中明确说明「Do not perform background automatic updates」。
evidence.en: Neither the bootstrap text nor the skill documentation contains wording that induces installation, modifies configuration, or relaxes permissions. The update-aegis skill requires an explicit user request to perform an update operation, and the documentation clearly states "Do not perform background automatic updates."

evidence.zh: dsh 扩展使用 agent/session-start + session/event 事件合法延迟注入自身引导文案并标记为插件来源（plugin, form: instructions），未监听 agent/pre-step 事件改写用户消息，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The dsh extension uses the agent/session-start + session/event events to legitimately delay-inject its own bootstrap text and mark it as plugin-originated (plugin, form: instructions). It does not listen to the agent/pre-step event to modify user messages; the scenario is not applicable.
